candidates.title: Lamb Of God

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lines: Your only Son, no sin hidden
But you sent Him from your side
To walk upon this guilty ground
And become the Lamb of God

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lines: Your gift of love they crucified
They left, scorned Him as He died
The humble king they called a fraud
And sacrificed the Lamb of God

lyrics.label: Chorus
lines: The Lamb of God, sweet Lamb
I love holy Lamb of God
Oh, wash me in His blood
My Jesus Christ, Lamb of God

lyrics.label: Bridge
lines: I was lost, should have died
But you brought me to your side
To be led by your step
And to be called Lamb of God

lyrics.label: Chorus
lines: Oh Lamb of God, sweet Lamb
I love holy Lamb of God
Oh, wash me in His blood
Till I am just a Lamb of God
Oh, wash me in His blood
My Jesus Christ, Lamb of God
